page.overview:
Who is Baron Daniel DeCobray?

Baron Daniel DeCobray is the husband of Ana Lewis in G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra is a scientist who worked for DeCobray Laboratoire Scientifique. He was killed by Storm Shadow when Ana kissed him, which she intended as he served his purpose for Cobra.
